matching_observations.comparability_note: report search dead time separately from matched payoff so aggregate averages span all rounds while in-match averages span matched rounds only
matching_observations.matching_efficiency_model: count search dead time as unmatched waiting rounds and do not fold it into average match length or market-thickness summaries

packet_intent: distill one tiny retained evidence packet from a rematch-world run, then compile it into the standard fill patch
scratch_retention_note: raw run traces and bulky intermediate tables may remain scratch-only once these distilled facts are retained

world_semantics_observations.asymmetry_trigger_policy: treat payoff asymmetry as active whenever role order changes realized payoffs or continuation probabilities
world_semantics_observations.rematch_state_carry_policy: carry forward bilateral continuation state inside the same partnership but not unmatched search history
world_semantics_observations.rematch_state_reset_policy: reset bilateral continuation state whenever a policy forms a new partnership after search
world_semantics_observations.role_assignment_policy: assign roles by ordered policy pair and emit a companion run whenever the payoff function is role-sensitive
world_semantics_observations.role_swapped_companion_policy: require one role-swapped companion run for each ordered pair whenever role-sensitive payoffs are enabled
